name: Balloon Knot
description: A glossy tangle of twisted modelling balloons in pink, cobalt and tangerine.
lighting: Hard window-shaped key, crisp speculars on latex
subject: either
prompt: A tight, glossy tangle of long twisted modelling balloons fills the frame, bubblegum pink, cobalt blue and tangerine looped over and under one another like a sculpture, each balloon one continuous tube pinched at its twist joints and finished with a small tied nub. Every curve carries one hard window-shaped highlight, and where the rubber stretches thin it turns faintly translucent with light glowing through. In the centre the loops open into a small cradle. Behind it all is a flat bubblegum-pink seamless. The palette is pink, cobalt and tangerine, playful, loud and slick.
